title: RecallGS: Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting
title_zh: RecallGS：面向在线语义高斯泼溅的几何接地召回

paragraphs.en: Online semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables open-vocabulary scene understanding from streaming observations. However, existing methods recover geometric context missing from image-derived semantic features using an additionally learned 3D network, incurring extra training and runtime overhead. We observe that such geometric-semantic evidence may already exist in the agent’s observation history and can be retrieved rather than learned. Based on this insight, we introduce RecallGS (Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting), a lightweight, training-free mechanism that treats past observations as a non-parametric geometric-semantic prior. RecallGS follows a recall-ground-fuse pipeline: CLIP retrieves relevant observations, alpha-compositing weights identify geometrically supported views, and aggregate their semantic features over each Gaussian’s rendered footprint. On ScanNet and ScanNet++, RecallGS achieves strong semantic segmentation performance at 2.48 FPS, demonstrating that geometric-semantic context can be effectively recovered from observation history without an additional learned 3D branch.
paragraphs.zh: 在线语义三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）能够从流式观测中实现开放词汇的场景理解。 然而，现有方法需要额外学习一个三维网络来恢复图像衍生语义特征中缺失的几何上下文，带来额外的训练与运行时开销。 我们观察到，这类几何-语义证据可能已经存在于智能体的观测历史中，可以被检索而非学习得到。 基于这一洞察，我们提出 RecallGS（面向在线语义高斯泼溅的几何锚定召回），这是一种轻量级、无需训练的机制，将历史观测视为非参数化的几何-语义先验。 RecallGS 遵循召回-定位-融合的流程：CLIP 检索相关观测，alpha 合成权重识别具有几何支持的视图，并在每个高斯的渲染足迹上聚合其语义特征。 在 ScanNet 和 ScanNet++ 上，RecallGS 以 2.48 FPS 达到了优异的语义分割性能，表明无需额外的可学习三维分支，也能从观测历史中有效恢复几何-语义上下文。

paragraphs.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an efficient explicit representation for real-time novel-view synthesis [ 11 ] . Recent works extend 3DGS with open-vocabulary semantics by distilling vision-language features into Gaussians, either through rendering-based supervision [ 19 , 22 , 30 ] or direct 3D feature lifting and referring [ 26 , 12 ] . This paradigm has further expanded to online embodied settings, using either language-aware 3DGS-SLAM [ 9 , 31 ] or generalizable feed-forward reconstruction [ 14 ] , alongside online 3D instance segmentation methods that fuse 2D foundation-model predictions into persistent 3D representations [ 27 , 24 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）为实时新视角合成提供了一种高效的显式表示 [ 11 ] 。 近期工作通过将视觉-语言特征蒸馏到高斯中，为 3DGS 扩展了开放词汇语义能力，方式包括基于渲染的监督 [ 19 , 22 , 30 ] 或直接的三维特征提升与指代 [ 26 , 12 ] 。 这一范式进一步扩展到在线具身场景，既可使用语言感知的 3DGS-SLAM [ 9 , 31 ] ，也可使用可泛化的前馈重建 [ 14 ] ，同时还有在线三维实例分割方法，将二维基础模型的预测融合到持久的三维表示中 [ 27 , 24 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Despite this progress, existing online semantic 3DGS pipelines recover the geometric context missing from image-derived language features through an additional learned 3D branch, rather than directly reusing geometric-semantic evidence from past observations. EmbodiedSplat [ 14 ] , for instance, complements its 2D CLIP features [ 21 ] with geometry-aware 3D features produced by passing the local Gaussian point cloud through a sparse 3D U-Net [ 6 ] equipped with a temporal memory adapter [ 28 ] . This 3D branch, however, must be trained on large-scale posed 3D indoor scene data, which is costly to collect and introduces additional GPU-memory consumption and latency that directly reduce the online reconstruction speed. EmbodiedSplat-fast removes the 3D U-Net and memory adapter, increasing throughput from 0.75 FPS to 5.18 FPS at the cost of geometric-semantic context. This highlights the training and inference overhead of recovering explicit 3D context through an additional learned branch. We ask whether such context must be learned at all, or can instead be recovered from the agent’s observation history.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，现有的在线语义 3DGS 流水线仍是通过一个额外训练的 3D 分支来恢复图像派生语言特征所缺失的几何上下文，而不是直接复用来自过往观测的几何-语义证据。 例如，EmbodiedSplat [ 14 ] 通过将局部高斯点云输入配备了时序记忆适配器 [ 28 ] 的稀疏 3D U-Net [ 6 ]，生成几何感知的 3D 特征，以补充其 2D CLIP 特征 [ 21 ]。 然而，这个 3D 分支必须在大规模带位姿的 3D 室内场景数据上训练，数据采集成本高昂，并且会引入额外的 GPU 显存消耗和延迟，直接降低在线重建速度。 EmbodiedSplat-fast 移除了 3D U-Net 和记忆适配器，将吞吐量从 0.75 FPS 提升到 5.18 FPS，但以牺牲几何-语义上下文为代价。 这凸显了通过额外训练分支来恢复显式 3D 上下文所带来的训练与推理开销。 我们提出疑问：这种上下文是否必须通过学习获得，还是可以改为从智能体的观测历史中恢复？

paragraphs.en: We observe that this trade-off is a consequence of treating each observation independently. An embodied agent operates in a persistent environment: a Gaussian that is geometrically or semantically ambiguous from the current viewpoint may correspond to a physical surface already observed earlier under a more favorable viewpoint, illumination, or occlusion pattern. This suggests that part of the geometric prior EmbodiedSplat’s 3D branch must learn from parameters could instead be recovered from the agent’s own trajectory, treating its accumulated observation history as a non-parametric geometric-semantic prior queried on demand rather than compressed once and discarded. However, effectively reusing past observations introduces several challenges. First, semantic similarity does not imply physical correspondence: a CLIP-based retrieval system [ 21 ] may return frames containing a visually similar object-another chair, table, or door-at an entirely different location. Second, a Gaussian may project inside a historical image but still be occluded by closer geometry. Sampling the projected pixel would then transfer features from the occluder rather than from the queried surface. Finally, exhaustively verifying every historical camera against every incoming frame would itself undermine the efficiency this history is meant to provide, as a long-running agent may accumulate hundreds to thousands of observations. The problem is therefore not retrieval of similar-looking memories, but memory routing: determining, without prior semantic knowledge of the current Gaussians, which past observations should be allowed to influence each one.
paragraphs.zh: 我们观察到，这种权衡是将每次观测独立处理所导致的结果。 具身的智能体运行在一个持续存在的环境中：从当前视角看在几何或语义上模糊的高斯，可能对应于早先在更有利的视角、光照或遮挡条件下已经观测到过的物理表面。 这表明，EmbodiedSplat 的 3D 分支必须从参数中学习的部分几何先验，其实可以改为从智能体自身的轨迹中恢复，即把其积累的观测历史视为一种可按需查询的非参数化几何-语义先验，而不是一次性压缩后丢弃。 然而，有效复用过去的观测会带来若干挑战。 首先，语义相似并不意味着物理对应：基于 CLIP 的检索系统 [21] 可能返回包含视觉相似物体的帧——另一把椅子、桌子或门——但位于完全不同的位置。 其次，一个高斯可能投影到某张历史图像内，但仍被更近的几何体遮挡。 此时对投影像素进行采样，会从遮挡物而非被查询表面转移特征。 最后，将每一台历史相机与每一帧新图像逐一穷尽验证，本身就会破坏这段历史旨在提供的效率，因为长期运行的智能体可能积累数百到数千条观测。 因此，问题不在于检索外观相似的记忆，而在于记忆路由：在对当前高斯缺乏先验语义知识的情况下，判定哪些过去的观测应被允许影响其中每一个高斯。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we propose RecallGS (Geometry-Grounded Recall), a lightweight mechanism requiring no additional training that treats an agent’s observation history as a queryable source of geometric-semantic evidence, routed to the current Gaussians through a recall–ground–replay pipeline. Our contributions are threefold: (1) semantic recall, a cheap CLIP-based retrieval stage that narrows an unbounded observation history to a small candidate pool of appearance-plausible frames; (2) geometric grounding, which reranks these candidates using alpha-compositing weights to identify views that geometrically support the current Gaussians; and (3) compositing fusion, which reuses the same alpha-compositing weights to aggregate historical features over each Gaussian’s full rendered footprint. Our experiments show that each component contributes independently to semantic accuracy, and that their combination enables effective geometric-semantic reasoning from observation history while maintaining efficient online inference
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出 RecallGS（几何锚定回溯，Geometry-Grounded Recall），这是一种无需额外训练的轻量级机制，它将智能体的观测历史视为可查询的几何-语义证据来源，并通过回溯—锚定—重放管线将其路由到当前的高斯分布中。 我们的贡献有三个方面：(1) 语义回溯，一个基于 CLIP 的低成本检索阶段，将无界的观测历史缩小到一个由外观上可能相关的帧组成的小型候选池；(2) 几何锚定，利用 alpha 合成权重对这些候选进行重排序，以识别在几何上支持当前高斯分布的视图；(3) 合成融合，复用相同的 alpha 合成权重，在每个高斯分布的完整渲染足迹上聚合历史特征。 我们的实验表明，每个组件都对语义准确性有独立贡献，并且它们的组合能够在保持高效在线推理的同时，实现基于观测历史的有效几何-语义推理。

paragraphs.en: We show that an agent’s observation history can serve as a non-parametric geometric-semantic prior, providing complementary semantic evidence without additional 3D training or per-scene optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，智能体的观测历史可以作为一种非参数的几何-语义先验，无需额外的3D训练或逐场景优化即可提供互补的语义证据。

paragraphs.en: We propose RecallGS , a training-free recall-ground-fuse framework that efficiently retrieves relevant past observations, grounds them against the current geometry, and fuses their semantic evidence into the current Gaussians.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 RecallGS，一个无需训练的「回忆—定位—融合」框架，它能高效检索相关的历史观测，将其与当前几何结构进行定位对齐，并将其语义证据融合到当前的高斯中。

paragraphs.en: We validate the contribution of each component and show that exploiting observation history consistently improves online semantic 3DGS while maintaining efficient inference.
paragraphs.zh: 我们验证了每个组件的贡献，并表明利用观测历史能够持续提升在线语义3DGS的性能，同时保持高效的推理。

paragraphs.en: Building on 3D Gaussian Splatting [ 11 ] , one line of work embeds open-vocabulary semantics onto Gaussians via per-scene optimization, either by distilling 2D vision-language features through differentiable rendering supervision [ 19 , 22 , 30 ] or by directly associating semantic features with 3D structure through clustering, feature lifting, or compact Gaussian-level representations [ 26 , 12 , 16 , 5 , 1 , 20 , 23 ] . These methods establish 3DGS as an effective carrier of language features and improve their spatial consistency, instance awareness, or representation efficiency. However, most construct semantic fields specifically for each scene, which limits their applicability when observations arrive continuously.
paragraphs.zh: 基于3D高斯泼溅[11]，一条研究路线通过逐场景优化将开放词汇语义嵌入到高斯上，要么通过可微渲染监督蒸馏2D视觉-语言特征[19, 22, 30]，要么通过聚类、特征提升或紧凑的高斯级表示将语义特征直接关联到3D结构[26, 12, 16, 5, 1, 20, 23]。 这些方法确立了3DGS作为语言特征的有效载体，并提升了其空间一致性、实例感知能力或表示效率。 然而，大多数方法为每个场景单独构建语义场，这限制了它们在观测持续到来时的适用性。

sents.zh: 基于3D高斯泼溅[11]，一条研究路线通过逐场景优化将开放词汇语义嵌入到高斯上，要么通过可微渲染监督蒸馏2D视觉-语言特征[19, 22, 30]，要么通过聚类、特征提升或紧凑的高斯级表示将语义特征直接关联到3D结构[26, 12, 16, 5, 1, 20, 23]。

sents.en: These methods establish 3DGS as an effective carrier of language features and improve their spatial consistency, instance awareness, or representation efficiency.
sents.zh: 这些方法确立了3DGS作为语言特征的有效载体，并提升了其空间一致性、实例感知能力或表示效率。

sents.en: However, most construct semantic fields specifically for each scene, which limits their applicability when observations arrive continuously.
sents.zh: 然而，大多数方法为每个场景单独构建语义场，这限制了它们在观测持续到来时的适用性。

paragraphs.en: To remove scene-specific optimization, a class of feed-forward methods predicts 3D Gaussian representations directly from input images without per-scene training. This paradigm was established by geometric backbones such as pixelSplat [ 2 ] and MVSplat [ 4 ] , which regress RGB Gaussians from sparse image pairs. Building on this feed-forward formulation, subsequent work adds an open-vocabulary semantic branch: LSM [ 8 ] jointly regresses geometry, appearance, and semantics from unposed image pairs by lifting a pre-trained 2D language-based segmentation model into a 3D-consistent feature field decoded into semantic Gaussians, SLGaussian [ 3 ] targets the sparse-view regime with a multi-view language memory bank that maps high-dimensional CLIP features to compact per-object IDs for fast open-vocabulary querying, and SemanticSplat [ 17 ] further improves language-aware feed-forward reconstruction by fusing SAM [ 13 ] and CLIP-LSeg [ 15 ] features into a cost-volume representation for cross-view semantic aggregation. These approaches avoid per-scene semantic optimization and generalize across scenes, but still operate on a fixed, small set of input views rather than maintaining a persistent semantic representation under a streaming observation sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 为了去除场景特定的优化，一类前馈方法直接从输入图像预测 3D 高斯表示，而无需针对每个场景进行训练。 这一范式由像素级几何骨干网络（如 pixelSplat [ 2 ] 和 MVSplat [ 4 ]）确立，它们从稀疏图像对中回归出 RGB 高斯。 在这一前馈式框架的基础上，后续工作增加了开放词汇语义分支：LSM [ 8 ] 通过将预训练的 2D 基于语言的分割模型提升为 3D 一致的特征场并解码为语义高斯，从无位姿图像对中联合回归几何、外观和语义；SLGaussian [ 3 ] 利用多视角语言记忆库面向稀疏视角场景，将高维 CLIP 特征映射为紧凑的逐物体 ID 以实现快速开放词汇查询；SemanticSplat [ 17 ] 则通过将 SAM [ 13 ] 与 CLIP-LSeg [ 15 ] 的特征融合进代价体表示以进行跨视角语义聚合，进一步改进了语言感知的前馈重建。 这些方法避免了逐场景的语义优化并能跨场景泛化，但它们仍然只在固定且少量的输入视角上运行，而无法在流式观测序列下维护一个持久化的语义表示。

paragraphs.en: A separate line of work extends 3DGS to the online setting required by embodied perception. Within visual SLAM, SplaTAM [ 10 ] and Gaussian Splatting SLAM [ 18 ] use explicit Gaussians for incremental tracking, mapping, and rendering, demonstrating that 3DGS can serve as a persistent scene representation under streaming observations. Building on this formulation, Online-LangSplat [ 9 ] and EA3D [ 31 ] inject language or foundation-model features into the online reconstruction loop. Online-LangSplat’s language module itself runs in milliseconds, but the overall SLAM-GS pipeline remains bottlenecked by per-frame camera-pose optimization, yielding well under 2 FPS end-to-end; EA3D similarly relies on a recurrent joint optimization module to align geometric and semantic features, at a comparable throughput cost. In parallel, online 3D instance segmentation methods incrementally fuse 2D foundation-model predictions into temporally consistent 3D instances [ 27 , 24 ] , building on adapter-based caching mechanisms that aggregate RGB-D features frame-by-frame to endow otherwise-offline backbones with temporal learning ability [ 28 ] ; these methods, however, operate on point-based representations rather than a differentiable and renderable Gaussian semantic field.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条独立的研究路线将3DGS扩展到具身感知所需的在线设置。 在视觉SLAM领域，SplaTAM [ 10 ] 和Gaussian Splatting SLAM [ 18 ] 使用显式高斯进行增量式跟踪、建图与渲染，证明3DGS可以作为流式观测下的持久场景表示。 在这一范式基础上，Online-LangSplat [ 9 ] 和EA3D [ 31 ] 将语言或基础模型特征注入在线重建循环中。 Online-LangSplat的语言模块本身以毫秒级速度运行，但整个SLAM-GS流程仍受限于逐帧相机位姿优化，端到端吞吐量远低于2 FPS；EA3D同样依赖一个循环联合优化模块来对齐几何与语义特征，吞吐量代价相当。 与此同时，在线3D实例分割方法将2D基础模型的预测增量式融合为时间一致的3D实例 [ 27 , 24 ] ，其基础是通过对RGB-D特征逐帧聚合的基于适配器的缓存机制，使原本离线的骨干网络具备时序学习能力 [ 28 ] ；然而，这些方法基于点式表示而非可微且可渲染的高斯语义场运行。

paragraphs.en: Closest to our setting are online, generalizable feed-forward pipelines that avoid per-scene optimization entirely. FreeSplat++ [ 25 ] targets efficient whole-scene indoor reconstruction from long image sequences, using a low-cost cross-view aggregation module and a pixel-wise triplet fusion strategy to incrementally merge overlapping Gaussian primitives across views, together with a weighted floater-removal step that exploits the accumulated blending weights from this fusion. EmbodiedSplat [ 14 ] extends this backbone with open-vocabulary semantics through a sparse CLIP codebook and a learned 3D U-Net branch that injects geometric context into image-derived semantic features. This improves geometric-semantic awareness but requires additional 3D training and incurs non-negligible inference overhead. In contrast, we recover complementary geometric-semantic evidence directly from the agent’s own observation history and route it to the current Gaussians through a lightweight recall-ground-fuse mechanism without an additional learned 3D semantic branch.
paragraphs.zh: 与我们的设定最接近的是完全避免逐场景优化的在线、可泛化的前馈流水线。 FreeSplat++ [ 25 ] 面向从长图像序列中高效重建完整室内场景，采用低开销的跨视角聚合模块和逐像素的三元组融合策略，跨视角增量式合并重叠的高斯基元，并结合一个利用该融合所累积的混合权重的加权去漂浮点步骤。 EmbodiedSplat [ 14 ] 在该骨干基础上，通过稀疏的 CLIP 码本和一个可学习的 3D U-Net 分支引入开放词汇语义，该分支将几何上下文注入由图像导出的语义特征中。 这提升了几何-语义感知能力，但需要额外的 3D 训练，并带来不可忽略的推理开销。 相比之下，我们直接从智能体自身的观测历史中恢复互补的几何-语义证据，并通过轻量级的“回忆—落地—融合”机制将其传递到当前的高斯上，而无需额外的可学习 3D 语义分支。

paragraphs.en: FreeSplat++ Following EmbodiedSplat [ 14 ] , we adopt FreeSplat++ [ 25 ] as the feed-forward reconstruction backbone. paragraphs.en: The candidate pool ℛ t \mathcal{R}^{t} obtained in Sec. 3.4 is constructed entirely from image-level appearance and carries no guarantee about the underlying 3D scene. Two frames may be assigned a high similarity score ρ j clip \rho_{j}^{\mathrm{clip}} simply because they share dominant visual attributes, such as similar wall color or furniture style, without observing any common physical surface; conversely, a historical camera 𝐄 j \mathbf{E}^{j} that does observe the region corresponding to Θ ^ l t \hat{\Theta}_{l}^{t} may receive only a modest score if the remainder of I j I^{j} is dominated by unrelated content. Using ℛ t \mathcal{R}^{t} directly as historical evidence would therefore risk contaminating the current Gaussians with semantics harvested from frames that never actually depicted the queried geometry. We resolve this ambiguity by explicitly verifying, for every candidate j ∈ ℛ t j\in\mathcal{R}^{t} , how much of Θ ^ l t \hat{\Theta}_{l}^{t} it renders once projected through the true camera geometry, rather than relying on appearance alone.

paragraphs.en: A naive verification would rasterize Θ ^ l t \hat{\Theta}_{l}^{t} from camera j j and treat a Gaussian as visible whenever its projected center falls within the image bounds, or equivalently whenever its screen-space radius is non-zero. paragraphs.en: Baselines. We compare RecallGS against representative open-vocabulary semantic 3DGS methods, including OpenGaussian [ 26 ] , Occam’s LGS [ 5 ] , Dr.Splat [ 12 ] , and InstanceGaussian [ 16 ] , as well as both EmbodiedSplat and EmbodiedSplat-fast [ 14 ] . Among them, EmbodiedSplat is the most relevant reference, as it augments the feed-forward reconstruction backbone with an additional geometry-aware 3D semantic branch, while EmbodiedSplat-fast removes this branch and relies only on the lightweight 2D semantic pathway. Since RecallGS is built upon EmbodiedSplat-fast, we use it as the primary baseline to isolate the benefit of historical semantic replay, while comparison with the full EmbodiedSplat evaluates whether historical evidence can recover geometry-aware semantic context without the additional 3D U-Net.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 我们将 RecallGS 与具有代表性的开放词汇语义 3DGS 方法进行比较，包括 OpenGaussian [26]、Occam's LGS [5]、Dr.Splat [12] 和 InstanceGaussian [16]，以及 EmbodiedSplat 和 EmbodiedSplat-fast [14]。 其中，EmbodiedSplat 是最相关的参考方法，它在前馈重建骨干网络上增加了一个额外的几何感知 3D 语义分支，而 EmbodiedSplat-fast 则移除了该分支，仅依赖轻量级的 2D 语义通路。 由于 RecallGS 是在 EmbodiedSplat-fast 的基础上构建的，我们将其作为主要基线，以隔离历史语义重放带来的收益；同时，与完整版 EmbodiedSplat 的比较则评估了历史证据能否在没有额外 3D U-Net 的情况下恢复几何感知的语义上下文。

paragraphs.en: Quantitative result Table 1 shows that RecallGS improves EmbodiedSplat-fast by 3.10 3.10 , 3.19 3.19 , 3.38 3.38 , and 3.22 3.22 mIoU on ScanNet-10/15/19 and ScanNet++-20, respectively, with corresponding mAcc gains. Although slower than EmbodiedSplat-fast ( 5.18 5.18 FPS), RecallGS provides a favorable accuracy–efficiency trade-off and compares favorably with per-scene methods while retaining online inference.
paragraphs.zh: 定量结果：表 1 显示，RecallGS 在 ScanNet-10/15/19 和 ScanNet++-20 上分别比 EmbodiedSplat-fast 提升了 3.10、3.19、3.38 和 3.22 mIoU，并带来了相应的 mAcc 提升。 它在保持与完整模型相当性能的同时，运行速度达到 2.48 FPS，而完整模型仅为 0.75 FPS（约快 3 倍）。 尽管比 EmbodiedSplat-fast（5.18 FPS）慢，RecallGS 提供了良好的精度–效率权衡，并在保持在线推理的同时优于逐场景方法。

paragraphs.en: Qualitative result: Fig. 2 demonstrates that RecallGS produces substantially more coherent semantic reconstructions, with cleaner region continuity and fewer fragmented or streak-like artifacts across large surfaces and object boundaries. In contrast, EmbodiedSplat exhibits pronounced local inconsistency, particularly in cluttered regions and partially observed structures. These results indicate that geometrically grounded historical replay provides complementary evidence that stabilizes semantic predictions across viewpoints and improves the consistency of the reconstructed semantic field.
paragraphs.zh: 定性结果：图2表明，RecallGS能够生成明显更加连贯的语义重建，在大面积表面和物体边界处区域连续性更干净，碎片状或条纹状的伪影更少。 相比之下，EmbodiedSplat表现出明显的局部不一致性，尤其是在杂乱区域和部分观测到的结构中。 这些结果表明，基于几何的历史回放提供了互补证据，能够跨视角稳定语义预测，并提升重建语义场的一致性。

paragraphs.en: We propose RecallGS, a lightweight mechanism requiring no additional training that recasts an embodied agent’s observation history as a non-parametric geometric-semantic prior via a recall-ground-fuse pipeline: retrieving plausible historical frames, verifying their geometric support through alpha-compositing responsibility, and fusing only this verified evidence into the current Gaussians. On ScanNet and ScanNet++, RecallGS narrows the gap to EmbodiedSplat’s full 3D branch with higher speed than the full model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 RecallGS，这是一种无需额外训练的轻量级机制，它通过“召回—地面—融合”流程，将具身智能体的观测历史重构为非参数化的几何—语义先验：检索合理的历史帧，通过 alpha 合成责任度验证其几何支撑，并仅将经过验证的证据融合到当前的高斯中。 在 ScanNet 和 ScanNet++ 上，RecallGS 缩小了与 EmbodiedSplat 完整 3D 分支的差距，且速度快于完整模型。

paragraphs.en: We observed that RecallGS’s quality is bounded by the past observations it relies on, offering limited benefit when historical views are sparse or low-quality and additionally, grounding rasterizes only the current local Gaussians, so occluders in the global map are not modeled and visibility may be overestimated. Future work may extend retrieval with a certainty or assessment gate that evaluates the reliability of a recalled observation, for instance based on viewpoint quality, illumination, or depth confidence, before allowing it to influence the current Gaussians.
paragraphs.zh: 我们观察到，RecallGS 的质量受限于其所依赖的历史观测，当历史视角稀疏或质量较低时收益有限；此外，其定位（grounding）仅对当前局部高斯进行栅格化，全局地图中的遮挡物未被建模，可见性可能被高估。 未来的工作可以扩展检索机制，加入一个确定性或评估门控，在让被召回的观测影响当前高斯之前评估其可靠性，例如基于视角质量、光照条件或深度置信度。
